title: Usage Attribution Fanout: Reconcile Per-Account Token Deltas from Streaming & Batch Sources
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Summary: We need a reliable fanout and reconciliation job that produces per-account token deltas by combining streaming telemetry (real-time request metering) with nightly batch aggregates (billing ETL). Current gaps cause double-counting when streaming and batch overlap and under-counting during bursty traffic. This ticket implements a deterministic reconciliation layer that emits final deltas used by downstream invoice and chargeback jobs.

Background:
- Streaming gateway writes event-level metering with request_id, route, model, token_counts to ks-metering stream (low-latency).
- Nightly batch jobs produce per-route aggregates from raw storage and enrichment (historical corrections, refunds).
- Existing ledgers ingest both sources; there is no single canonical fanout causing conflicts and manual adjustments.

Goals / Acceptance criteria:
- Produce an authoritative per-account token delta stream (topic: acct-token-deltas) with idempotent keys and strong provenance metadata (source, window, canonicalizer_version).
- Reconciliation job must detect overlapping records and apply last-write-wins using sequence numbers and an explicit 'reconciled' flag.
- Nightly reconciliation latency < 45 minutes after batch completion.
- Reconciliation must be auditable: generate a reconcile-report that surface diffs and anomalies (>1% delta) to Slack channel #billing-alerts and a dashboard (Grafana).
- No customer-visible billing changes until opt-in canary and verification are complete.

Proposed design (high level):
1) Streaming pre-aggregation: streaming consumer produces incremental per-account, per-route partial deltas keyed by (account_id, date, model_variant). Each record contains: partial_tokens, seq_no, window_start, source=stream.
2) Batch aggregate writer: existing nightly aggregate job publishes per-account aggregates with source=batch and seq_no set to batch_epoch.
3) Reconciler service (this ticket):
   - Fanout reads both topics (stream-partials, batch-aggregates) for the reconciliation window.
   - For each (account, date, model_variant) we build a timeline ordered by seq_no and source priority (batch > stream only for finalized windows).
   - Apply deterministic merge: prefer batch aggregates for closed windows, otherwise accumulate stream partials. Emit final delta to acct-token-deltas with provenance headers and a reconciliation_signature.
4) Downstream contracts: billing-ledger consumes acct-token-deltas and marks line-items as reconciled=true when reconciliation_signature present.

Trade-offs & decisions:
- Chose late-binding reconciliation rather than only single-source authoritative write to avoid service disruption during rollouts and to support historical corrections from batch. This increases complexity but maintains correctness for corrections.
- Using batch-as-authority for closed windows simplifies customer billing audits at cost of occasional latency for final numbers.
- We considered a two-phase commit to ledger writes but rejected due to increased coupling and scale limits across distributed ledgers.

Implementation notes / tasks:
- New reconciler microservice (Go) with Kafka consumer groups reading stream-partials and batch-aggregates. Use RocksDB local state for windowed merges; checkpoint offsets to S3 for restart.
- Schema changes: add "reconciliation_signature", "provenance.source", "provenance.seq_no" to acct-token-deltas proto. Backwards compatible; default fields omitted when not available.
- Add reconciliation-report generator (lambda) that computes per-account diffs and posts top-100 anomalies to S3 and Slack.
- Add e2e tests: synthetic traffic generator to produce stream-partials overlapping with batch-aggregates and assert final deltas match expected.

Progress log (high level):
- 2025-02-12: PRD drafted and reviewed with PM/Finance (Asha Patel), and infra constraints discussed.
- 2025-02-16: Spike complete: prototype reconciler reading both topics, uses local RocksDB to merge windows. Prototype handles 5k accounts/sec in perf run. Notes in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.company/billing/reconcile-spike (internal).
- 2025-02-18: Schema PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/protos/pull/412 (proto additions). Awaiting proto-owner approval.
- 2025-02-20: Design review with Security & Compliance. Concern raised about provenance fields containing PII. Decision: redact PII at producer boundary, add account_hash field instead. Security sign-off pending data-retention policy mapping.
- 2025-02-21: Implementation started: consumer scaffold, RocksDB state, checkpointing. Working branch: github.com/redwood-inference/reconciler/compare/ENG-23571-fanout.

Open questions / blockers:
- Which team owns the reconciliation signature verification (ledger team vs reconciler)? Action: sync with Ledger owners (ENG-21456) to agree on signature format.
- IAM access for reconciler to write reconciled messages to acct-token-deltas topic and S3 path for reports. Infra ticket raised (ENG-23602).
- Capacity for long-tail accounts: current prototype evicts cold windows aggressively. Need policy for eviction vs spilling to S3. Decision due by 2025-02-26.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (canary): run reconciler in read-only mode (emit reports only) for 48h against last 7 days (no writes). Validate diffs < 0.5% for top customers.
- Phase 2 (shadow writes): reconciler writes to acct-token-deltas in a shadow topic and billing-ledger reads shadow to validate end-to-end without impacting billing.
- Phase 3 (gradual flip): slice by customer tier (internal, beta, 10% customers, then 100%) with monitoring.

Testing & Observability:
- Metrics: reconciler.processed_windows, reconciler.emit_rate, reconciler.diff_percentile_95, reconciler.error_rate.
- Dashboards: reconciliation-latency, top-deltas-by-account, anomaly-alerts.
- Alerts: >1% diff for any customer for a 24h window -> page on-call billing SRE and post to #billing-alerts.

PRs & artifacts:
- Proto change: github.com/redwood-inference/protos/pull/412
- Reconciler WIP: github.com/redwood-inference/reconciler/compare/ENG-23571-fanout
- Spike notes & perf results: https://confluence.redwood.company/billing/reconcile-spike
- Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.company/billing/reconciliation-design-ENG-23571

Review feedback incorporated so far:
- PM (Asha Patel): prioritize auditability and human-readable reports. Added reconciliation-report design.
- Security (Olivia Martinez): remove direct PII, add account_hash; update retention policy mapping.
- Eng Lead (Marcus Chen): prefer RocksDB local state with S3 checkpoints vs purely in-memory state.

Next steps (short-term):
- Complete proto PR and get approval (owner: Jenna Liu) — target 2025-02-24.
- Finish IAM ticket and infra permissions (ENG-23602) — target 2025-02-25.
- Implement S3 checkpointing and eviction policy tests — target 2025-02-26.
- Create canary run plan and test dataset, coordinate with Finance for validation (Asha Patel).
